AUTHOR: Levy
TITLE: Automated Analysis of Marine Video With Limited Data
REGION: Underwater: Labeled Fishes in the Wild (US West Coast rockfish footage) + AFSC workshop images; aerial dataset: Mediterranean coast, Israel (out of scope)
SPECIES: Fish (single class, no species labels); aerial part: shark/ray/diver
DATA: Labeled Fishes in the Wild [7] subset (463 re-annotated images) + 45 AFSC images; 42 independent underwater test images; own UAV aerial footage
V_EV: Sec. 5.1: 'The dataset contains challenging images with low visibility, different scales, and cluttered background (examples in Figs. 1,2).'
D2: 448 train / 60 val images; 42 independent test images from different videos
D_EV: Sec. 5.2: 'These images did not participate in the training (neither in the validation set) and were not taken from videos of which frames were taken to the training set.'
R_EV: Fig. 10 caption: 'The underwater test examples are different than the training images by several factors: fish species, water color, lighting conditions and scale.' (qualitative only)
C_EV: Sec. 5.2: 'In the evaluation we consider only detections that have a confidence level above 0.4.'
E_EV: Sec. 5.2: 'For the Fish class in the fish dataset it was 0.74.' (only AP reported; counting/length via tracking shown qualitatively in Fig. 9 only)
ARCH: RetinaNet (ResNet + FPN, focal loss, Keras-RetinaNet) + SORT tracker (Tlost=5)
NOTE: Mixed paper: aerial UAV shark/ray dataset (out of scope) and underwater fish dataset; coded for the underwater component only. PLAT/ENV not stated in the text for the underwater images (Labeled Fishes in the Wild is externally known to be ROV footage, but the paper does not say so). D1: train/val split unit (448/60) is not stated; the independent 42-image test set is explicitly separated at video level, so D1 coded as video with D4=Y. R: generalization to different species/water colour/illumination is shown only as example images (Fig. 10) with no metrics, hence R3=N and R_ALL=P. C_ALL=N: single threshold 0.4 used as-is; the only false-positive discussion concerns missing ground-truth annotations inflating FP counts (Fig. 8), not detector uncertainty — a verifier may consider this borderline (C4=Y recorded for FP discussion). PRE: ImageNet backbone then COCO-trained detection subnets; coded as COCO. E: tracking is said to 'enable counting and measuring' but no counts, lengths or comparison with human data are reported, so E1=없음. Authors state they 'plan to release' test sets (not yet shared → DSHR=N). NIMG = 448+60+42 underwater images.
